files.worker.py:
import pathlib,signal,sys
import ioprio
label=sys.argv[1];ioprio.set(0,int(sys.argv[2]),int(sys.argv[3]))
pathlib.Path('ready-'+label).write_text('ready\n')
while True:signal.pause()
files.calls.py:
import ioprio,json,pathlib,sys
first,dead,last=map(int,sys.argv[1:]);names={first:'first',dead:'reaped',last:'last'}
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in open('trace')]
assert rows, 'no I/O-priority syscall reached the reference operation'
for row in rows:
 assert row['arg0']==1 and row['arg1'] in names,row
 row['arg1']=names[row['arg1']]
pathlib.Path('calls.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print('first=%s,%s'%ioprio.get(first));print('last=%s,%s'%ioprio.get(last))
files.check.py:
import errno,ioprio,json,os,pathlib,sys
first,dead,last,rc=map(int,sys.argv[1:5]); ignored=int(sys.argv[5])
assert rc==(0 if ignored else 1),rc
out=pathlib.Path('out').read_text(); err=pathlib.Path('err').read_text()
assert not out,out
if ignored: assert not err,err
else:
 assert len(err.splitlines())==1 and ('ioprio_set (pid %d)'%dead) in err and os.strerror(errno.ESRCH) in err,err
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in pathlib.Path('trace').read_text().splitlines()]
assert rows==[dict(syscall='ioprio_set',arg0=1,arg1=pid,arg2=(2<<13)|6,reply=('errno:3' if pid==dead else 'continue')) for pid in (first,dead,last)],rows
assert ioprio.get(first)==(2,6) and ioprio.get(last)==(2,6) and ioprio.get(dead)==(0,0)
print('contract=ok')

cases.purpose: Verify ordered repeated PID sets across a injected failure for a live owned target, including ignore semantics.
cases.oracle: Explicit multiple-PID contract, seccomp syscall trace with an injected middle-target ESRCH, and independent ioprio_get read-back.
cases.comparison: Exact status and diagnostic checks, ordered syscall arguments, and both live owned process priorities.
cases.setup_script:
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/ionice-owned-seccomp.py --notify ioprio_get --reply ioprio_get=EINVAL --log-args ioprio_get=0,1 --log probe -- /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import ctypes,errno;lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True);assert lib.syscall(252,1,0)==-1;assert ctypes.get_errno()==errno.EINVAL'
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json;assert [json.loads(s) for s in open("probe")]==[{"arg0":1,"arg1":0,"reply":"errno:22","syscall":"ioprio_get"}]'
rm -f probe
cases.script:
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
/usr/bin/python3 worker.py one 0 0 & first=$!
/usr/bin/python3 worker.py two 0 0 & last=$!
/usr/bin/python3 worker.py middle 0 0 & dead=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$first" "$dead" "$last" 2>/dev/null; wait "$first" "$dead" "$last" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 ready.py one two middle || exit 90
export IONICE_OWNED_TARGETS="$first,$dead,$last"
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/ionice-owned-seccomp.py --notify ioprio_set --log-args ioprio_set=0,1,2 --log trace -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c 'ionice  -c 2 -n 6 -p "$1" -p "$2" -p "$3"' fixture "$first" "$dead" "$last" > out 2> err; rc=$?
/usr/bin/python3 check.py "$first" "$dead" "$last" "$rc" 0 || exit 91
rm -f out err trace
